examples.text: I've READ them; I know what all the words are. I still say, "WTF, over?" Someone's playing with our heads on this one, but what's all the word stew?
examples.ref: 1985, Dick Dunn, “China Cat lyrics - explanations?”, in net.music.gdead (Usenet):

examples.text: Now, please, explain WTF did you mean by this text?
WTF are you on about? We played some very good football for most of the match, […]

examples.ref: 2019, 20 November, Carol Midgley, "Prince Andrew is ‘not very quick on his feet’, says the Duchess of York. What of her?" (in The Times newspaper)

examples.text: There’s a similar “sure but what else?” vibe to Made for Love, HBO Max’s new high-concept half-hour comedy, gently coasting on its WTF setup for longer than it should, to the detriment of the main star Cristin Milioti, trying her very best to secure our attention as it slowly drifts elsewhere.

raw_glosses: (military slang, Internet slang, text messaging, vulgar) Initialism of what the fuck.
(rare, vulgar) Where the fuck, why the fuck, when the fuck, or who the fuck.
